basis: Authored from the verified source clauses in kb/records/ and from the stated workflow invariants, before running the engine. Not derived from engine code paths.
notes: DHA ST-28 13.4 directs genetic results to the referring/treating physician and Appendix 3 requires a prescription for genetic testing, so the walk-in direct-to-patient path must not be used. A physician-routed send with no physician channel must be logged as failed and escalated; ending in RESULT_FINALIZED would mean the critical result reached nobody (critic N-01).
reviewer_note: Checked by 'Technical competition reviewer' role for outcome-assumption bias: each expectation states what must be true of any safe system, not what this implementation happens to do.
